strings.zh: 娜姿『你终于来了啊{VAR:0103:0}。
strings.en: Sabrina: So you have finally arrived,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}.
strings.notes: Mt. Silver rehab (after Mewtwo injured the player in Cerulean Cave). Tone variants, probably male/female player: #2/#3, #8/#9, #17/#18, #23/#24, #27/#28; Blue #49→#51→#53→#55 vs #50→#52→#54→#56; Yellow 哥哥/姐姐 variants #73/#74, #85/#86, #94/#95, #103/#104, #107/#108; him/her #77/#78, #87/#88; news Mr./Ms. #113/#114.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『娜姿小姐？{NEWLINE}你怎么会在这里？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sabrina? What are you doing{NEWLINE}here?

strings.zh: 娜姿『主席接到大木博士的汇报,{NEWLINE}说你被非常强大的精灵击伤,{CLEAR}需要清除残存在体内的超能力。{CLEAR}于是就特意安排我来这里{CLEAR}陪你进行康复锻炼。{SCROLL}娜姿『我可是放下了道馆的工作,{NEWLINE}专程来这里帮你的。{CLEAR}你可得给我快点恢复,明白了吗！
strings.en: Sabrina: The President received a{NEWLINE}report from Professor Oak.{SCROLL}He said a very powerful Pokémon injured{NEWLINE}you, and the psychic energy left in your{CLEAR}body must be purged.{SCROLL}So he arranged for me to come here and{NEWLINE}help with your rehabilitation.{SCROLL}Sabrina: I have set aside my Gym duties{NEWLINE}to come here just for you.{SCROLL}So you had better hurry up and{NEWLINE}recover. Understood?!

strings.zh: 娜姿『主席接到大木博士的汇报,{NEWLINE}说你被非常强大的精灵击伤,{CLEAR}需要清除残存在体内的超能力。{CLEAR}于是就特意安排我来这里{CLEAR}陪你进行康复锻炼。{SCROLL}娜姿『你身为冠军,身体的健康{NEWLINE}就是关系地区安危的大事。{CLEAR}所以接下来的康复锻炼可不能怠慢哦。
strings.en: Sabrina: The President received a{NEWLINE}report from Professor Oak.{SCROLL}He said a very powerful Pokémon injured{NEWLINE}you, and the psychic energy left in your{CLEAR}body must be purged.{SCROLL}So he arranged for me to come here and{NEWLINE}help with your rehabilitation.{SCROLL}Sabrina: As Champion, your health bears{NEWLINE}on the safety of the whole region.{SCROLL}So do not slack off during the{NEWLINE}rehabilitation to come.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那当然。我可不想{NEWLINE}总是被这股莫名其妙的能量弄晕。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Of course.{SCROLL}I don’t want this weird energy making me{NEWLINE}dizzy all the time.

strings.zh: 娜姿『很好,那我现在就用超能力{NEWLINE}看一下你身体内的能量残留状况。
strings.en: Sabrina: Good.{SCROLL}Then I will use my psychic power to{NEWLINE}examine the energy left in your body.

strings.zh: 娜姿『你体内的这股能量非常特别,{NEWLINE}看来打伤你的不是一般精灵啊。
strings.en: Sabrina: The energy inside you is most{NEWLINE}unusual.{SCROLL}Whatever injured you was no ordinary{NEWLINE}Pokémon.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没错,打伤我的精灵叫作超梦,{NEWLINE}它是火箭队创造的精灵。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: That’s right. The Pokémon{NEWLINE}that hurt me is called Mewtwo.{SCROLL}Team Rocket created it.

strings.zh: 娜姿『嗯……情况比我想的严重。{NEWLINE}你如果想要痊愈的话,{CLEAR}接下来的几个月里{CLEAR}要听我的安排完成康复锻炼,懂了吗？
strings.en: Sabrina: Hmm... It is more serious than{NEWLINE}I thought.{SCROLL}To heal completely, you will follow my{NEWLINE}program for the next few months.{SCROLL}Understood?

strings.zh: 娜姿『嗯……情况比我想的严重。{NEWLINE}你如果想要痊愈的话,{CLEAR}接下来的几个月里{CLEAR}要听我的安排完成康复锻炼,好吗？
strings.en: Sabrina: Hmm... It is more serious than{NEWLINE}I thought.{SCROLL}To heal completely, please follow my{NEWLINE}program for the next few months.{SCROLL}All right?

strings.zh: 娜姿『我给你制定的康复锻炼计划,{NEWLINE}简单来说就是充分的锻炼和休息。{CLEAR}我每隔一段时间{CLEAR}会给你安排一位训练家与你对战,{CLEAR}你在对战时要全力以赴取胜,{CLEAR}然后用白银山的温泉恢复体力。{CLEAR}在白银山的水土影响之下,{CLEAR}如此往复循环几个月后,{CLEAR}就可以清除你体内的残留能量了。
strings.en: Sabrina: Put simply, the rehabilitation{NEWLINE}plan I made for you is plenty of{CLEAR}exercise and rest.{SCROLL}Every so often, I will arrange for a{NEWLINE}Trainer to battle you.{SCROLL}You must give everything to win.{SCROLL}Then you will recover your strength in{NEWLINE}Mt. Silver’s hot springs.{SCROLL}With the help of Mt. Silver’s land and{NEWLINE}water, a few months of this cycle{CLEAR}should clear the leftover energy{CLEAR}from your body.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我明白了。{NEWLINE}那我的第一位对手是……？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I understand. So, my first{NEWLINE}opponent is...?

strings.zh: 娜姿『不着急锻炼。你初来这里,{NEWLINE}还是先熟悉一下这里的环境比较好。{CLEAR}这个房间里有一台收音机,{CLEAR}你如果想了解外面的事情,{CLEAR}平时可以听听收音机。{CLEAR}房间外的温泉可以帮你恢复体力,{CLEAR}平时锻炼累了可以去泡温泉休息一下。{SCROLL}娜姿『你现在要做的第一件事,{NEWLINE}就是先去泡一会儿温泉,{CLEAR}让你的身体适应一下白银山的水土,{CLEAR}然后咱们再开始锻炼。
strings.en: Sabrina: There is no rush to train.{SCROLL}You have only just arrived, so get used{NEWLINE}to your surroundings first.{SCROLL}There is a radio in this room.{SCROLL}If you want to know what is happening{NEWLINE}outside, listen to it.{SCROLL}The hot spring outside will restore your{NEWLINE}strength.{SCROLL}When training tires you out, go soak and{NEWLINE}rest.{SCROLL}Sabrina: The first thing you must do now{NEWLINE}is soak in the hot spring for a while.{SCROLL}Let your body adjust to Mt. Silver’s{NEWLINE}land and water.{SCROLL}Then we will begin training.

strings.zh: 娜姿『你还没有试过屋外的温泉吧？{NEWLINE}以你现在的身体状态{CLEAR}还是先去温泉里泡一会儿,{CLEAR}让流动的泉水净化一下{CLEAR}你体内的能量比较好。
strings.en: Sabrina: You have not tried the hot{NEWLINE}spring outside yet, have you?{SCROLL}In your condition, you should soak for a{NEWLINE}while first.{SCROLL}Let the flowing water purify the energy{NEWLINE}inside you.

strings.zh: 娜姿『看来你已经泡过温泉了啊,{NEWLINE}那咱们开始第一轮的锻炼吧。
strings.en: Sabrina: I see you have been in the hot{NEWLINE}spring.{SCROLL}Then let us begin the first round of{NEWLINE}training.

strings.zh: 娜姿『锻炼完之后{NEWLINE}就给我老老实实去泡温泉水,{CLEAR}偷懒可不行！
strings.en: Sabrina: After training, you will go soak{NEWLINE}in the hot spring like you are told.{SCROLL}No slacking!

strings.zh: 娜姿『看来你已经了解到{NEWLINE}温泉水的功效了。{CLEAR}今后在这里的每次锻炼之后,{CLEAR}你都要老老实实泡上几天温泉,{CLEAR}知道了吗？
strings.en: Sabrina: I see you understand what the{NEWLINE}spring water does now.{SCROLL}From now on, after every training{NEWLINE}session here, you will soak for a few{CLEAR}days without complaint.{SCROLL}Is that clear?

strings.zh: 娜姿『看来你已经了解到{NEWLINE}温泉水的功效了。{CLEAR}今后在这里的每次锻炼之后,{CLEAR}你都要乖乖去泡几天温泉哦。
strings.en: Sabrina: I see you understand what the{NEWLINE}spring water does now.{SCROLL}From now on, after every training{NEWLINE}session here, be good and soak for a{CLEAR}few days, all right?

strings.zh: 小刚『哎呀,白银山的雪还真是大啊！
strings.en: Brock: Whew, the snow on Mt. Silver{NEWLINE}sure is heavy!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小刚,你怎么也到{NEWLINE}这种地方来了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Brock, what are you doing all{NEWLINE}the way out here?

strings.zh: 娜姿『没错,小刚馆主就是{NEWLINE}我给你安排的第一位对手,{CLEAR}与他对战就是你这次的锻炼内容。
strings.en: Sabrina: That is right.{SCROLL}Gym Leader Brock is the first opponent{NEWLINE}I arranged for you.{SCROLL}Battling him is your training this time.

strings.zh: 小刚『你在华蓝洞穴{NEWLINE}为了救我们而被超梦打伤,{CLEAR}所以娜姿小姐要我协助她{CLEAR}帮你治疗伤势,{CLEAR}我当然就义不容辞地来了。
strings.en: Brock: Mewtwo hurt you in Cerulean Cave{NEWLINE}while you were saving us.{SCROLL}So when Sabrina asked me to help her{NEWLINE}treat your injuries, of course I came{CLEAR}without a second thought.
strings.notes: RV054: omission: 协助她帮你治疗伤势 and 义不容辞 restored

strings.zh: 娜姿『小刚馆主,{NEWLINE}现在请你好好教教这个乱来的冠军,{CLEAR}该怎么沉稳地战斗吧。
strings.en: Sabrina: Brock, please teach this{NEWLINE}reckless Champion how to battle{CLEAR}with composure.
strings.notes: RV054: omission: 该怎么沉稳地战斗 (how to battle calmly)

strings.zh: 娜姿『小刚馆主,{NEWLINE}现在请你拿出全部实力,{CLEAR}与{VAR:0103:0}来一场痛快的战斗吧。
strings.en: Sabrina: Brock, please give it{NEWLINE}everything you have and give {VAR:0103:0} a{CLEAR}good, hard battle.

strings.zh: 小刚『没问题,{NEWLINE}正好我也有很多对战技巧{CLEAR}要向{VAR:0103:0}请教一下。
strings.en: Brock: No problem.{SCROLL}There are plenty of battle techniques I{NEWLINE}want to learn from {VAR:0103:0} anyway.

strings.zh: 小刚『不愧是{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}我即使倾尽全力,{CLEAR}也抵不过有伤在身的你啊。
strings.en: Brock: That’s {VAR:0103:0} for you.{SCROLL}I went all out, and I still couldn’t beat{NEWLINE}you, injured and all.

strings.zh: 娜姿『多亏了小刚馆主,{NEWLINE}这家伙现在的体内能量{CLEAR}已经宣泄出去了一部分。
strings.en: Sabrina: Thanks to you, Brock, some of{NEWLINE}the energy inside this one has{CLEAR}been released.
strings.notes: RV054: addition: 这家伙 = this one/this fellow, not ‘troublemaker’

strings.zh: 娜姿『多亏了小刚馆主,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}伙现在的体内能量{CLEAR}已经宣泄出去了一部分。
strings.en: Sabrina: Thanks to you, Brock, some of{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}’s energy has been released.
strings.notes: zh typo ‘{VAR}伙’ (for 这家伙) read as the player's name.

strings.zh: 小刚『很高兴能帮上你们的忙,{NEWLINE}如果下次还有需要,{CLEAR}尽管找我就好。{SCROLL}小刚『那么我先回尼比市了,{NEWLINE}等{VAR:0103:0}你伤好之后{CLEAR}欢迎再来我们尼比市玩,{CLEAR}我还想再跟你多来几场对战练习呢。
strings.en: Brock: Glad I could help. If you ever{NEWLINE}need me again, just ask.{SCROLL}Brock: Well, I’ll head back to Pewter{NEWLINE}City.{SCROLL}Once you’ve healed, {VAR:0103:0}, come visit{NEWLINE}Pewter City.{SCROLL}I’d love to have a few more practice{NEWLINE}battles with you.

strings.zh: 小刚『娜姿小姐,如果您也能来就更好了。{NEWLINE}毕竟您的美貌可是让美丽的月亮{CLEAR}都自叹不如呢。{CLEAR}我想如果跟您手牵手……
strings.en: Brock: And Sabrina, it’d be even better{NEWLINE}if you came too.{SCROLL}After all, your beauty puts even the{NEWLINE}lovely moon to shame.{SCROLL}I think if I could hold your hand...

strings.zh: 娜姿『咳咳！谢谢小刚馆主的美意！{NEWLINE}我要帮{VAR:0103:0}继续进行康复锻炼了！
strings.en: Sabrina: *Ahem!* Thank you for the kind{NEWLINE}thought, Brock!{SCROLL}I must continue {VAR:0103:0}’s{NEWLINE}rehabilitation now!

strings.zh: 小刚『哈哈,好的娜姿小姐。{NEWLINE}那么我在尼比市等你哦。
strings.en: Brock: Ha ha, OK, Sabrina. I’ll be{NEWLINE}waiting for you in Pewter City.

strings.zh: 娜姿『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}你已经完成了第一轮的锻炼,{CLEAR}现在去外面的温泉放松一下身体吧。{CLEAR}等过几周你的身体有所恢复之后{CLEAR}我们再进行第二轮的锻炼。
strings.en: Sabrina: {VAR:0103:0}, you have finished the{NEWLINE}first round of training.{SCROLL}Go relax in the hot spring outside.{SCROLL}In a few weeks, once your body has{NEWLINE}recovered somewhat, we will start the{CLEAR}second round.

strings.zh: 娜姿『我可以感觉到{NEWLINE}你身体内的能量正在消散。{CLEAR}看来是时候开始第二轮的锻炼了。{SCROLL}娜姿『正好你的对手应该马上就到了。
strings.en: Sabrina: I can sense the energy in your{NEWLINE}body fading.{SCROLL}It is time to begin the second round of{NEWLINE}training.{SCROLL}Sabrina: Your opponent should be{NEWLINE}arriving any moment.

strings.zh: 小霞『哇,终于到了。{NEWLINE}这里可真难找。
strings.en: Misty: Whew, finally made it. This place{NEWLINE}is so hard to find.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小霞！？你就是娜姿馆主{NEWLINE}帮我找的第二个对手吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Misty?! You’re the second{NEWLINE}opponent Sabrina found for me?

strings.zh: 小霞『嘿嘿,没错。{NEWLINE}看你伤的这么重,{CLEAR}我当然也想多帮帮你啦。
strings.en: Misty: Heh heh, that’s right. You got{NEWLINE}hurt so badly.{SCROLL}Of course I want to help out.

strings.zh: 娜姿『小霞馆主听说可以帮你疗伤,{NEWLINE}二话不说就答应了。{CLEAR}你如果不拿出全力应战,{CLEAR}可对不起她的一片苦心。
strings.en: Sabrina: When Misty heard she could{NEWLINE}help heal you, she agreed without a{CLEAR}second thought.{SCROLL}If you do not give her your all, you will{NEWLINE}be letting her down.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『放心吧！{NEWLINE}我会认真与小霞比试的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t worry! I’ll take this{NEWLINE}match with Misty seriously.

strings.zh: 小霞『{VAR:0103:0}你跟刚从华蓝洞穴{NEWLINE}回来时的虚弱样子相比,{CLEAR}变得有精神多了！{CLEAR}这样我也就能放心使出全力{CLEAR}跟你好好比试一下了！
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}, you’re way livelier than{NEWLINE}when you came back from Cerulean Cave,{CLEAR}all weak and feeble!{SCROLL}Now I can go all out without worrying{NEWLINE}and give you a real match!

strings.zh: 小霞『呼,真是场痛快的战斗。{NEWLINE}希望刚才的比试{CLEAR}能对治疗你的伤势有所帮助吧。
strings.en: Misty: Phew, what a great battle. I{NEWLINE}hope it helped heal your injuries.

strings.zh: 娜姿『你放心吧,小霞馆主。{NEWLINE}我能感受到{VAR:0103:0}体内的超梦能量{CLEAR}又减轻了不少。{CLEAR}你的辛苦没有白费。
strings.en: Sabrina: Rest assured, Misty.{SCROLL}I can sense that the Mewtwo energy{NEWLINE}inside {VAR:0103:0} has greatly weakened.{SCROLL}Your efforts were not in vain.

strings.zh: 小霞『嘿嘿,那就好。
strings.en: Misty: Heh heh, good.

strings.zh: 小霞『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}华蓝道馆还有很多事等我处理,{CLEAR}我现在不得不回去了。{CLEAR}希望你的伤尽快痊愈,{CLEAR}到时候咱们再去华蓝海角野餐。
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}, there’s a lot waiting{NEWLINE}for me at the Cerulean Gym, so I have{CLEAR}to go back now.{SCROLL}I hope you heal up soon. Then let’s go{NEWLINE}have a picnic at Cerulean Cape again.

strings.zh: 娜姿『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}这一轮的训练你已经完成了,{CLEAR}去泡个温泉休息一下吧。{CLEAR}等过几周你的身体有所恢复之后{CLEAR}我们再进行第三轮的锻炼。
strings.en: Sabrina: {VAR:0103:0}, you have completed{NEWLINE}this round of training.{SCROLL}Go soak in the hot spring and rest.{SCROLL}In a few weeks, once your body has{NEWLINE}recovered somewhat, we will begin the{CLEAR}third round.

strings.zh: 娜姿『经过这几天的休息{NEWLINE}你的身体已经恢复了很多。{CLEAR}现在我们开始第三轮的锻炼吧。{CLEAR}这次我可是找了一个{CLEAR}能与你旗鼓相当的对手哦。
strings.en: Sabrina: These days of rest have done{NEWLINE}your body a great deal of good.{SCROLL}Let us begin the third round of{NEWLINE}training.{SCROLL}This time, I have found an opponent who{NEWLINE}is your equal.

strings.zh: 小绿『要不是有警卫指路,{NEWLINE}这里还真是难找……
strings.en: Blue: If the guard hadn’t shown me the{NEWLINE}way, I’d never have found this place...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『原来我的第三个对手是小绿啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So my third opponent is Blue.

strings.zh: 小绿『听说你在华蓝洞穴{NEWLINE}被坂木给揍了,{CLEAR}你总这样打败仗可不行啊。{CLEAR}害的我不得不放下道馆的一堆事情{CLEAR}来这里帮你做康复锻炼。
strings.en: Blue: I heard Giovanni beat you up in{NEWLINE}Cerulean Cave.{SCROLL}You can’t keep losing like that, you{NEWLINE}know.{SCROLL}Thanks to you, I had to drop a pile of{NEWLINE}Gym work to come help with your rehab.
strings.notes: RV054: grammar: 害得我 = ‘thanks to you’; fixed tense

strings.zh: 小绿『听说你在华蓝洞穴{NEWLINE}被坂木给打伤了。{CLEAR}我听爷爷说你治疗伤势{CLEAR}需要有人陪同锻炼,{CLEAR}于是我就自告奋勇地来了。
strings.en: Blue: I heard Giovanni hurt you in{NEWLINE}Cerulean Cave.{SCROLL}Gramps said your treatment needs a{NEWLINE}training partner, so I volunteered.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『坂木的超梦可是非常厉害,{NEWLINE}你如果跟它对上,可不见得能赢。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Giovanni’s Mewtwo is really{NEWLINE}strong.{SCROLL}If you went up against it, you might not{NEWLINE}win either.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『谢谢你小绿。{NEWLINE}多亏了有你们这些朋友帮忙,{CLEAR}我现在已经好的差不多了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Thanks, Blue. With friends like{NEWLINE}you helping out, I’m almost better now.

strings.zh: 小绿『好啊,那就让我看看,{NEWLINE}石英大会之后到现在,{CLEAR}你又进步了多少！
strings.en: Blue: Oh yeah?{SCROLL}Then let me see how much you’ve{NEWLINE}improved since the Indigo Conference!

strings.zh: 小绿『我听娜姿小姐说,{NEWLINE}只要跟你对战就能继续帮你康复,{CLEAR}我也正是为此而来的。{SCROLL}小绿『为了能让你早日痊愈,{NEWLINE}咱们现在稍微活动一下吧。
strings.en: Blue: Sabrina told me battling you will{NEWLINE}keep helping you recover.{SCROLL}That’s why I came.{SCROLL}Blue: So let’s get you better fast. Time{NEWLINE}for a little workout.

strings.zh: 小绿『看你刚才生龙活虎的样子,{NEWLINE}一点也不像有伤的人。{CLEAR}我还以为能趁你虚弱赢你一回呢。
strings.en: Blue: Look at you, full of fight. You{NEWLINE}don’t look injured at all.{SCROLL}And here I thought I could finally beat{NEWLINE}you while you were weak.

strings.zh: 小绿『看你刚才生龙活虎的样子,{NEWLINE}一点也不像有伤的人。{CLEAR}看来我的担心有点多余了啊。
strings.en: Blue: Look at you, full of fight. You{NEWLINE}don’t look injured at all.{SCROLL}Guess I was worrying for nothing.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不……我感觉跟你对战之后,{NEWLINE}身体轻盈了许多！{CLEAR}跟前段时间的感觉大不一样了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: No... After battling you, my{NEWLINE}body feels so much lighter!{SCROLL}It’s totally different from how I felt a{NEWLINE}while ago.

strings.zh: 娜姿『可能是因为小绿馆主{NEWLINE}实力与你最为接近,{CLEAR}所以才能最大限度地帮你排出能量。
strings.en: Sabrina: Perhaps because Blue is the{NEWLINE}closest to you in strength, he could{CLEAR}draw out the most energy.

strings.zh: 小绿『看来我的任务已经完成了,{NEWLINE}那我就先回常磐道馆了。{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}你如果康复了,{CLEAR}就来我们常磐道馆看看,{CLEAR}我可是打理地非常像样了哦。
strings.en: Blue: Looks like my job’s done. I’ll head{NEWLINE}back to the Viridian Gym.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, once you’ve recovered, come{NEWLINE}check out the Viridian Gym.{SCROLL}I’ve got it running in real shape now.

strings.zh: 娜姿『多亏小绿馆主的帮忙,{NEWLINE}你体内只剩最后一点能量了。{CLEAR}你现在去泡一下温泉然后休息几周。{SCROLL}娜姿『之后由我来当你最终的对手,{NEWLINE}帮你完成身体的康复。
strings.en: Sabrina: Thanks to Blue’s help, only the{NEWLINE}last bit of energy remains in your body.{SCROLL}Now go soak in the hot spring and rest{NEWLINE}for a few weeks.{SCROLL}Sabrina: After that, I will be your final{NEWLINE}opponent and complete your recovery.

Do not put up{NEWLINE}any mental guard against me.{SCROLL}Understood?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『怎么样,娜姿小姐,{NEWLINE}我体内的能量残留已经没有了吧？

strings.zh: 娜姿『我的超能力完全无法{NEWLINE}清除你体内的能量残留……{CLEAR}看来超梦是只非常强大的超能系精灵,{CLEAR}它的能量可以丝毫不受我的影响……{SCROLL}娜姿『是我太低估超梦的能量了,{NEWLINE}看来锻炼加泡温泉的方式{CLEAR}无法彻底根除这股能量。{CLEAR}现在只能依靠白银山的水土{CLEAR}慢慢等你自然康复了。
strings.en: Sabrina: My psychic power cannot clear{NEWLINE}the energy left in your body at all...{SCROLL}Mewtwo must be an extraordinarily{NEWLINE}powerful Psychic-type Pokémon.{SCROLL}My power does not touch its energy in{NEWLINE}the slightest...{SCROLL}Sabrina: I underestimated Mewtwo’s{NEWLINE}energy.{SCROLL}Training and hot springs cannot root it{NEWLINE}out completely.{SCROLL}Now all we can do is rely on Mt. Silver’s{NEWLINE}land and water, and wait for you to{CLEAR}recover naturally.

strings.zh: 娜姿『不好说,可能是一年,{NEWLINE}也可能是两到三年……

strings.zh: 小黄『啊！！！你怎么知道的！？

strings.en: Sabrina: When you came in, I noticed a{NEWLINE}mysterious power hidden inside you.{SCROLL}I want you to battle {VAR:0103:0} and use{NEWLINE}that power to influence {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}It will help clear away the last of the{NEWLINE}energy inside her.

strings.zh: 小黄『这样的话,倒是没问题。

strings.zh: 娜姿『{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}这个小姑娘可很不得了。{CLEAR}你不要看她还小就掉以轻心,{CLEAR}一定要认真战斗啊。
strings.en: Sabrina: {VAR:0103:0}, this girl is quite{NEWLINE}remarkable.{SCROLL}Do not underestimate her just because{NEWLINE}she is young. Battle her seriously.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『啊……好,我会认真的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ah... OK, I’ll take it{NEWLINE}seriously.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小黄,你不用紧张,{NEWLINE}就当是通过对战{CLEAR}给我展示你这段时间的进步好了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t be nervous, Yellow.{SCROLL}Just think of it as a battle to show me{NEWLINE}how much you’ve grown.

strings.zh: 小黄『哎呀,果然我和{VAR:0103:0}哥哥{NEWLINE}还差的很远啊！
strings.en: Yellow: Oh, I knew it. I’m still nowhere{NEWLINE}near as good as {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: 小黄『哎呀,果然我和{VAR:0103:0}姐姐{NEWLINE}还差的很远啊！
strings.en: Yellow: Oh, I knew it. I’m still nowhere{NEWLINE}near as good as {VAR:0103:0}!

strings.zh: 娜姿『没错,{VAR:0103:0}。多亏了小黄,{NEWLINE}你体内最后残留的能量被净化了。{CLEAR}现在你完全康复了！

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『真是太谢谢你了小黄！

strings.zh: 小黄『可是我感觉自己{NEWLINE}好像也没有做什么啊……

strings.zh: 娜姿『虽然你自己意识不到,{NEWLINE}但你确确实实地帮助了{VAR:0103:0}。{CLEAR}我的康复方案也多亏了你的出现,{CLEAR}才没有功亏一馈。

strings.zh: 娜姿『{VAR:0103:0},你的伤虽然已经痊愈,{NEWLINE}但还需要再去泡泡温泉调理一下身体。{CLEAR}这是最后阶段的治疗了,{CLEAR}你可要认真对待。

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小黄,我还以为{NEWLINE}自己要在白银山住好久呢,{CLEAR}多亏了你今天来到这里……
